children: ITC Limited (NSE:ITC) reported Q2 FY2026-27 beats in hotels and faster managed portfolio expansion—strong room revenue, occupancy and EBITDA growth—while adding hotels, securing assets and planning a Dubai subsidiary, even as analysts offer mixed ratings ahead of broader FMCG and volume guidance for H2.
Previous Week Recap
ITC Limited Results Outlook
: ITC Limited (ITC) reports Q2 FY2026-27 results. Traders will watch FMCG EBIT growth, cigarette and non-cigarette volume trends, pricing, margins and rural demand guidance for H2 FY27.
ITC Hotels Q2 Metrics Rise
: ITC Limited hotels Q2: room revenue +22% YoY; occupancy 76% (+481 bps); ADR +14%; RevPAR +21%; EBITDA margin 32%; EBITDA ₹314 crore (+28%).
Analysts Mixed Ahead Of Results
: Analysts mixed on ITC ahead of results: MOFSL Neutral TP Rs285, HDFC Securities Add TP Rs200. Shares closed roughly 0.74% higher prior session, edging up pre-results.
Nomura Raises ITC Hotels Target
: Nomura raised ITC Hotels target to Rs 205 and kept Buy after Q2FY27 revenue and EBITDA beat estimates by 8% and 13%; Nomura also lifted FY27–28 EPS forecasts.
ITC Adds 20 Hotels In H1 FY27
: ITC Limited (ITC) added 20 hotels (1,600+ keys) in H1 FY27, lifting managed pipeline to 84 hotels (~8,200 keys). Land for a 200+‑key Lucknow luxury hotel secured; FY27–FY31 pipeline ~1,114 keys.
Welcomhotel Ahmedabad Owned Launch
: ITC Limited's hospitality arm took ownership and began operating the 130-key Welcomhotel Ahmedabad from September 1, 2026, marking its shift to an owned hotel under ITC Hotels' asset strategy.
Managed Hotel Portfolio Growth
: ITC Limited reports faster expansion of its managed hotel portfolio in India; MD Anil Chadha cites rising openings and more first-time hotel owners joining ITC Hotels’ managed properties.
Fortune Select Greater Noida Opening
: ITC Hotels adds 105-room Fortune Select Greater Noida under Asset Right. Opening early next year at India Expo Plaza, it targets corporate and MICE with rooms, dining and banquets.
Dubai Hotel Subsidiary Planned
: ITC Limited plans a wholly owned Dubai hotel subsidiary to run hotels and restaurants. Board okayed 100% subscription and up to ₹20 crore initial equity, pending Dubai approvals.
Welcomhotel Manesar Contract Signed
: ITC Limited’s hospitality arm signed a contract for a 104-room Welcomhotel in Manesar, Gurugram, expanding its NCR footprint to serve Delhi, Gurugram, Noida and Faridabad markets.
